parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: after req.reject(requeue=False) in the ETA conversion exception handler, there is no return, so eta stays None and execution falls through, running the rejected task. Description A focuses on immediate execution ignoring ETA and missing result-backend storage; Description B focuses on the fall-through reaching task_reserved/handle and rate-limit bucket queuing. The core failure is the same, at the same location.
